name: unsafe fn set_len (& mut self , new_len : usize)
rule: `new_len` must be less than or equal to `self.capacity()` when calling `Vec::set_len`.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::vec::Vec < T , A > { unsafe fn set_len (& mut self , new_len : usize) }
